segments.he: כשדיברו למוהרנ"ת ז"ל שידוך אחר מיתת אשתו הראשונה דברו לו על אשה א' ושיש לה כמה מאות רובל. ענה ואמר כשיש לה כמה וכמה מאה מיתות רח"ל כי כשיש מאה רובל יש לו מאה מיתות רח"ל וכשיש לו ב' מאות רובל יש לו ב' מאות מיתות (כשאין משתמשים בזה בקדושה):
segments.en: At that same time of the military conscriptions, a woman had a son who was to be taken as a soldier. She went to the cemetery and wept so much that her soul departed from her. They told this before Moharan'as. He said: "What did she accomplish with this? She died — and she did not save her son. But if she had gone every day for an hour or more and prayed and pleaded before Hashem — she would not have died, and she would also have saved her son through this. And she would also have saved many, many Jewish souls through this."
